# Bundle Index

This is a hand-written OKF (Open Knowledge Format) bundle-root index,
per SPEC.md §8. It carries no frontmatter at all — the reserved-filename
skip in internal/kb/content.go must treat it as a navigation artifact,
not a concept.

* [Tables](tables/) - BigQuery tables in this bundle.
* [Reviews](reviews/) - Narrative concepts and attested figures.
